blocks.text: On the Usage Insights page, you can view AI application usage across departments, users, locations, and sensitive data.
The Usage Insights pages provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Provide you with actionable insights into an organization's AI usage patterns between users and applications.
Present usage patterns of the application across an organization.
Analyze granular details of usage patterns based on segment groups, user groups, and users.
Review usage patterns to design better access policy rules.
Quickly drill down on insights with the help of multiple filters and operators available.

blocks.text: On the Usage Insights page (Public AI > Usage Insights), you can view insights for the following tabs:

blocks.item: Users
Use this tab to view usage insights for users.
Select the time period for which you want to see the data. You can select the Last 1 Day, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, Last Month, or Last Quarter.
Filter the data for specific Departments, Application Type, or Policy Actions (Allowed, Blocked, or Isolated).
Total Volume: View the total volume of data generated by the users.
Search by a specific user.

The Users column populates the data determined by your selections. Each user tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
Select the User for which you want to view the data.

The Apps column populates the data determined by your selections. Each apps tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
You can view the total number of apps. You can also search for a specific app.
Departments
Use this tab to view usage insights for departments.
Select the time period for which you want to see the data. You can select the Last 1 Day, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, Last Month, or Last Quarter.
Filter the data for specific Departments, Application Type (Gen AI or Embedded AI), or Policy Actions taken (Allowed, Blocked, or Isolated).
Total Volume: View the total volume of data generated by the department.

The Departments column populates the data determined by your selections. Each application tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the department.
Select the department for which you want to view the data.

The Apps column populates the data determined by your selections. Each apps tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
Select the app for which you want to view the data.
The Users column is updated for the selected app. Each user tile shows the volume of data geenerated by them and the percentage contribution to the total transactions generated by all the users.
You can view the total number of users. You can also search for a specific user.
Locations
Use this tab to view usage insights for locations.
Select the time period for which you want to see the data. You can select the Last 1 Day, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, Last Month, or Last Quarter.
Filter the data for specific Locations, Application Type (Gen AI or Embedded AI), or Policy Actions taken (Allowed, Blocked, or Isolated).
Total Volume: View the total volume of data generated by the department.

The Locations column populates the data determined by your selections. Each location tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the location.
You can view the total number of locations. You can also search for a specific location.
Select the location for which you want to view the data.

The Apps column populates the data determined by your selections. Each app tile shows the volume of data generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
Select the app for which you want to view the data.
The Users column is updated for the selected app. Each user tile shows the volume of data generated by them and the percentage contribution to the total transactions generated by all the users.
You can view the total number of users. You can also search for a specific user.
Sensitive Data
Use this tab to view usage insights for sensitive data.
Select the time period for which you want to see the data. You can select the Last 1 Day, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, Last Month, or Last Quarter.
Filter the data for specific Policy Actions taken (Allowed, Blocked, or Isolated) or Content Type (DLP Engine, DLP Dictionary, or ML Category).
Number of Transactions: View the number of transactions.

The Applications column populates the data determined by your selections. Each application tile shows the number of transactions generated by them and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
Select the application for which you want to view the data.

The <Content Type> column populates the data determined by your selections. Each tile shows the number of transactions and their percentage contribution to the total incidents generated by the application.
Select the <Content Type> column for which you want to view the data.
The Users column is updated for the selected Content Type. Each user tile shows the number of users and the percentage contribution to the total transactions generated by all the users.
You can view the total number of users. You can search data for a specific user.
